# Objective 7 — Demo-Ready EOS Application

## Goal

Build EOS into a coherent demo-ready Enterprise Intelligence Platform.

## Demo Flow

Website / Enterprise Input
→ Enterprise Discovery
→ Digital Intelligence Profile
→ Mission Control
→ Opportunity Assessment
→ AI Workforce Recommendation
→ Digital Twin Placeholder
→ Second Balance Sheet Signal

## Build Rule

Focus only on demo-critical functionality.

Do not expand architecture unless required to complete the demo loop.

## Frontend Deliverables

- Clean Enterprise Journey UI
- Discovery input screen
- Mission Control Runtime panel
- Digital Intelligence Profile panel
- Opportunity Assessment panel
- AI Workforce Recommendation panel
- Digital Twin Placeholder panel
- Second Balance Sheet Signal panel

## Backend Deliverables

- Demo runtime endpoint
- Discovery output
- Opportunity assessment output
- AI Workforce recommendation output
- Digital Twin placeholder output
- Second Balance Sheet signal output

## Acceptance Test

A user enters an enterprise website and EOS returns a complete demo-ready Mission Control view showing:

- Enterprise name
- Discovery confidence
- Digital Intelligence Profile
- Opportunities
- AI Workforce recommendations
- Digital Twin status
- Second Balance Sheet signal
- Recommended next actions

## Definition of Done

Objective 7 is complete only when the demo flow works in the browser and is committed.

Implementation Sequence

1. Enterprise Discovery
2. Digital Intelligence Profile
3. Opportunity Assessment
4. AI Workforce Recommendation
5. Digital Twin Placeholder
6. Second Balance Sheet Signal
7. Mission Control Dashboard

Each stage produces an enterprise object.

Mission Control displays every object.
